summary: Simon Property Group, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 9, 2026 with J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, PNC Capital Markets and Wells Fargo as representatives, covering a $400 million tranche of 5.250% notes due February 15, 2032 and a $400 million tranche of 5.650% notes due October 1, 2036, for $800 million total. Notes were issued September 16, 2026 under the existing indenture via a forty-ninth supplemental indenture. Interest is semi-annual, first payable February 15, 2027 and April 1, 2027. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown, not a special situation; watch only spread and refinancing economics.
